CI-03 (review W1–W5): write_p50_ns is the matrix's ingestion (W6) row — the mean commit wall per put (fsync-bound, sync durability); scan_p50_ns is the type scan (W5) row; compact_wall_ms + compact_allocs are the compaction_smoke cell — one merge of two 25K-key segments under a counting allocator. write_per_sync (the gated write cell): the W6 commit cost divided by a plain sync_all on the same disk in the same run (the 'machine sync (ref)' row) — dimensionless, so the machine cancels; 1.01 = the median of three runs on darwin/arm64 (APFS, F_FULLFSYNC) measuring 1.00/1.01/1.04 while the absolute wall moved 25%. write_p50_ns stays as the reported laptop reference.
